name: Galdor
subtitle: Councilor From The West
game_text:
To play, spot an Elf.
<phase>Regroup</phase>: Exert Galdor and spot a minion to return that minion to its owner’s hand.
flavor_text: “‘My heart tells me that Sauron will expect us to take the western way, when he learns what has befallen. He soon will.’”
